leadText: Pokémon Pocket Comics: XY (Japanese: ポケモンＸ・Ｙ爆笑４コマまんが全集 Pokémon X & Y Laughter 4Koma Comic Compilation) is a Pokémon 4Koma created by 春風邪三太 Santa Harukaze with cooperation from ShoPro and design by Sasaki Tariji. It is 240 pages long.
